h1: Glacier Hotel Khon Kaen — a 4-star city hotel with rooms bigger than the price suggests
intro: If you're in Khon Kaen and want a central base within walking distance of the City Pillar Shrine, the train station and the nightlife area — without paying top dollar — Glacier Hotel Khon Kaen is a name that comes up often. It's a boutique 4-star on Pracha Samran Road, open since 2010 and with rooms renovated in 2023. What guests praise most is that the rooms are noticeably bigger than the price tag suggests, plus there's an indoor pool and free parking. Rates start from around THB 1,000/night, and it scores 8.9 from 476 reviews.

body.html: What gets Glacier talked about in Khon Kaen is that the rooms are bigger than other hotels at a similar price. Deluxe rooms start from around 32 sqm, with a large bed, a fridge, a flat-screen TV and a work desk. After the 2023 renovation many rooms look cleaner and more contemporary. The air conditioning is another thing guests mention — reviews repeatedly call it strong and cold, which matters a lot in the Isan heat.

Location is the strongest card. The hotel sits in central Khon Kaen on Pracha Samran Road, within 500–600 metres of both the City Pillar Shrine and Khon Kaen train station. There are restaurants, markets and cafés to walk to all around, and Central Plaza Khon Kaen and Khon Kaen University are a short drive away. For anyone here on business, for a conference, or dropping a child off to study at the university, this kind of location is convenient and saves on transport.
"The room was much bigger than expected and the air-con was freezing cold. Staff were helpful, and you can easily walk to the train station and the City Pillar. Good value for a stay in town."

Service scores well too — staff get praised for being friendly and quick to help. There's an indoor swimming pool, which is uncommon at this level in Khon Kaen, an on-site restaurant, and free parking that's very handy if you're driving. The communal areas and lobby look tidy. The location sub-score reaches 9.3, and cleanliness and service both sit at 8.9.

Now the honest part — the most common complaint is inconsistent maintenance, even after the partial room renovation. Reviews mention a rusted showerhead, weak water pressure in some rooms, and broken fixtures. Some rooms have air conditioning that can't be set properly — it stays freezing no matter the thermostat. A few guests found windows sealed shut, and there are complaints about the pool water occasionally looking cloudy. The upshot is that room quality is uneven, depending on whether you land a renovated room or not.

Another thing to know: a city-centre location comes with noise from the nightlife area. Rooms facing the road or near the bars can pick up sound on Friday and Saturday nights, so if you're a light sleeper, ask for an inner-facing or higher-floor room when booking. Overall, 8.9 from 476 reviews is strong for the price, and almost everything dragging the score down is about maintenance rather than location or service.

Bottom line: Glacier isn't a design-led boutique where everything is pristine. It's a well-located city hotel with spacious rooms at an affordable price, ideal for people here on business in Khon Kaen, for a conference, or for a one- or two-night stop. If you expect every room to feel brand new you may be a little disappointed, but for a central stay with big rooms, cold air-con, and a walk to the train station and City Pillar for around a thousand baht, it's a solid pick.

A tip from following the reviews here for a while: ask for a renovated room (Premium or Grand Deluxe) and an inner-facing one when you book — the condition is clearly better and it's quieter. If you're coming during a big Khon Kaen event like the Silk Festival or the university graduation period, rooms fill fast, so book ahead and lock in a free-cancellation rate.

faq.q: Where is Glacier Hotel Khon Kaen and what's nearby?
faq.a: It's at 141 Pracha Samran Road in central Khon Kaen. It's about 510 m to the City Pillar Shrine and 580 m to Khon Kaen train station on foot. Central Plaza Khon Kaen, Bueng Kaen Nakhon Lake and Khon Kaen University are a short drive away, and the airport is around 15 minutes by car.

faq.q: How much does Glacier Hotel cost and what rooms are there?
faq.a: Prices start at around THB 1,000/night for a Deluxe Double (around 32 sqm). A Deluxe Twin runs about THB 1,100, a Grand Deluxe around THB 1,300, and a Premium Room around THB 1,500. Rates move with the season and city events, so compare a few platforms before booking.

faq.q: Are the rooms really spacious, and what condition are they in?
faq.a: The rooms are noticeably bigger than hotels at a similar price, which is what guests praise most. Deluxe rooms start at around 32 sqm with a large bed and strong cold air-con. The hotel renovated part of its rooms in 2023, but quality is uneven — un-renovated rooms may have a rusted showerhead or broken fixtures, so request a Premium or Grand Deluxe room when you book.

faq.q: Is it noisy — is it OK for light sleepers?
faq.a: The hotel is central, near the nightlife area, so road-facing rooms can pick up noise on Friday and Saturday nights. If you're a light sleeper, ask for an inner-facing or higher-floor room when booking — it's clearly quieter.

faq.q: Who is Glacier Hotel best for?
faq.a: It's ideal for people here on business in Khon Kaen, for a conference, or for a one- or two-night stop — within walking distance of the train station and City Pillar, with spacious rooms, cold air-con and an affordable rate. It also suits anyone visiting Khon Kaen University. It's less suited to those expecting a polished design boutique in every room.

faq.q: Does it have a pool and parking?
faq.a: Yes — there's an indoor swimming pool, which is uncommon at this price in Khon Kaen, plus free parking, very convenient for a self-drive trip. Some reviews note the pool water can occasionally look cloudy, so check the condition before swimming.
